svg.text: A martini glass: chapters, then open
# line, limit, rules, words, others, finding, how: as before
still = alt.Scale(domain=[0, 180]) # the axis stays still
Drawn at chapter 1, as it opens; built on the highlight slide’s
Buttons 1 to 3 under the chart: the chapter.
The stem: the notes arrive at chapter 2.
The bowl: every road, at the end.
Points, so the tooltip answers for the year you point at.
